title: Approve and mirror the Vault bootstrap toolchain and chart
classification_reason: writes approved OCI artifacts to private ECR
expected_outcome: The dedicated Vault bootstrap toolchain and the SHA-verified Vault chart have approved immutable references and are copied to their private ECR destinations with recorded digest verification.
constraints: Only approved immutable digests and the reviewed Vault chart 0.31.0 checksum may be published or mirrored.
Use GitHub Actions and ECR only for the scoped toolchain publication and artifact copy; retain only non-sensitive evidence.
Do not run Terraform apply, CodeBuild, Helm, kubectl, Vault, EKS access-policy mutation, secret access, or workload deployment.
Do not treat a missing nested Helm OCI repository as permission to create it outside a separately reviewed Terraform apply.

external_actions: read public GHCR and Helm artifact metadata
push the reviewed task branch needed to execute its versioned GitHub Actions workflows
dispatch and monitor the reviewed GitHub Actions toolchain release workflow
publish the reviewed Vault bootstrap toolchain to the repository GHCR package
dispatch and monitor the reviewed GitOps OCI mirror workflow to copy approved digests to the existing private ECR Vault repository
read private ECR repository and image digest metadata

primary_owner.responsibility: artifact approval, delivery boundary, integration, and final sign-off
